Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
The Last Backpack You'll Need
I grew up in the days of using paper bags as book covers, and the era of the basically indestructible Jansport backpacks. But now that we live in the internet age, it was time to get a backpack that could safely hold my laptop among other things. The first thing that caught my attention is the color - the sage green shade is one of my favorites and I was thrilled to get a backpack in this hue. The second thing I noticed was how light it is. It doesn't take up much space, but it has plenty of padding and makes me feel secure enough to trust that it'll protect my laptop and other items. There is a padded pouch in the back that can fit my MacBook Air, my iPad, or any of my other electronic device securely. It has padding on both sides, and the back of the backpack is mesh and breathable. There are pockets throughout - one for a laptop, one opposite that to secure items, and two separate pockets on the front, one of which has two inner pockets for pens, styluses, or other items you might want to keep apart from the rest of your things. The back is padded with a mesh overlay, keeping my back cool when I use this, and it has a stretchy pocket on the side for a water bottle. The straps are padded as well, and I love that a strap comes all the way around from the back and snaps to secure the backpack and prevent anyone from sneaking anything out of it. I will absolutely be using this to carry my laptop around and for short excursions. I love that I can safely store my laptop or tablet and still have room to put clothes, papers, books, or anything I need to bring when getting away for a day or two.

  • Andromeda
    4 out of 5 stars
    Nicely made, lightweight with lots of room. great color
    Reviewed in the United States on August 24, 2026
    Color: Sage Green
    Vine Customer Review of Free Product
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This is a better backpack for the price than I'd imagined! When I saw mention of a 15.6" laptop I thought the bag would be slimmer, and was completely wrong - I misunderstood one of the images in the product listing. If you put a laptop in the main compartment instead I think it will fit a 16" easily even if the laptop is in it's own lightweight sleeve to protect it. One of the photos shows a 15.6" that I carry a lot in the main compartment and there is a lot more room for books, notes, food and so on. It's also roomy enough for spare clothes, and for use as an overnight bag.

    The sewing is good, and the zippers are securely inserted. They're not particularly heavyweight or rugged, like a backpack you might take on expeditions and adventures, but it's not that type of backpack and I don't think they're an issue for everyday use. There were a few loose threads, but if you were holding it in a store you might pull them out and buy it anyway.

    There is a care label sewn inside indicating that it can be machine washed and hung in the shade to dry, great for a bag that will probably get a lot of use.

    The bottom doesn't have any reinforcement or feet to protect it against wet or dirty surfaces, and in the end that's the reason for removing one star from the rating. So if you're travelling on trains or subways, or through wet or snowy weather, you might need to watch where you set it down. Otherwise, it looks durable, the color is perfect and easy to spot, and it's a great buy around 30$.

  • Another Vine Reviewer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Bravo for This Bagstellar Backpack!
    Reviewed in the United States on August 19, 2026
    Color: Sage Green
    Vine Customer Review of Free Product
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This review is for Bagstellar Laptop Backpack for Women, Puffer, selling for $32.99 at the time of my review.

    I am quickly becoming a huge fan of Bagstellar products! This is my third or fourth. I've lost count. Each is well constructed. Each is ample. Each is awesome. Each is both beautiful AND functional ... it's a one, two punch.

    This back-pack is no exception. I love it and I haven't even used it for it's true function ... yet ... and will when I return to college. How do I love it? Let me count the ways ...

    1) Padded wide straps

    2) Five zippered compartments, one is hidden, one is inside

    3) Five non-zippered compartments and/or pockets, one deep and large and on the inside, two on the outside for bottles (both bottle compartment have a strap to securely fasten bottles into place), and two cell-phone size inside one of the zippered compartments

    4) All the lining in all of the compartments are water resistant for easy cleaning

    5) The sage color is gorgeous

    6) It's really roomy

    7) It's well constructed and it's sturdy.

    What I do not like in any design of any product is if the designer never really used them in real life. Like some vacuum cleaners have awkward placing of the cords, or my iPhone has a button on the side where I keep inadvertently turning the thing off. It should be placed on the top!

    Anyhoo, I feel as this backpack was designed by a student who understands the specific needs of students who use backpacks regularly.

    BRAVO Bagstellar for another job well done!

    5 out of 5 stars
    Lightweight, Super Cute, and Fits My 40oz Tumbler!
    Reviewed in the United States on August 17, 2026
    Color: Sage Green
    Vine Customer Review of Free Product
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I am absolutely in love with this backpack! The quilted puffer material is super soft, trendy, and gives it a chic, high-end look without feeling bulky.

    Here is why it’s easily a 5-star bag for me:

    Insanely Lightweight: At just over a pound, it adds virtually no weight on its own. Even when loaded up with my 15.6" laptop, notebooks, chargers, and a pouch, it feels comfortable to carry all day thanks to the padded straps.

    The Side Pocket Actually Fits Giant Tumblers: If you carry a 30oz or 40oz tumbler everywhere like I do, you know how hard it is to find a backpack pocket that fits it. The elastic side pocket with the adjustable buckle strap holds my large cup completely secure with zero risk of tipping out!

    Smart Storage & Easy Access: The double zipper on the main compartment makes grabbing things super convenient. Everything has its place—my laptop stays safe in its sleeve, and there are plenty of organized pockets for small items like my keys, phone, and lip balm.

    Travel-Ready: The luggage strap on the back made navigating the airport a breeze on my last trip, and it slipped right under the seat in front of me with no issue. Plus, the water-resistant material is super easy to wipe clean if anything spills.

    Whether you're a student, teacher, nurse, or just need a stylish work/travel bag, this puffer backpack hits the spot. Function meets fashion—10/10 recommend!

    Reviewed in the United States on August 17, 2026
    Color: Sage Green
    Vine Customer Review of Free Product

    I am absolutely in love with this backpack! The quilted puffer material is super soft, trendy, and gives it a chic, high-end look without feeling bulky.

    Here is why it’s easily a 5-star bag for me:

    Insanely Lightweight: At just over a pound, it adds virtually no weight on its own. Even when loaded up with my 15.6" laptop, notebooks, chargers, and a pouch, it feels comfortable to carry all day thanks to the padded straps.

    The Side Pocket Actually Fits Giant Tumblers: If you carry a 30oz or 40oz tumbler everywhere like I do, you know how hard it is to find a backpack pocket that fits it. The elastic side pocket with the adjustable buckle strap holds my large cup completely secure with zero risk of tipping out!

    Smart Storage & Easy Access: The double zipper on the main compartment makes grabbing things super convenient. Everything has its place—my laptop stays safe in its sleeve, and there are plenty of organized pockets for small items like my keys, phone, and lip balm.

    Travel-Ready: The luggage strap on the back made navigating the airport a breeze on my last trip, and it slipped right under the seat in front of me with no issue. Plus, the water-resistant material is super easy to wipe clean if anything spills.

    Whether you're a student, teacher, nurse, or just need a stylish work/travel bag, this puffer backpack hits the spot. Function meets fashion—10/10 recommend!

    Little things really do impress me.

    This company wrapped this puffer backpack in a dust cover. The backpack totally deserves that. It's great marketing but it also shows me the company takes pride in their products.

    Puffer backpacks have become wildly popular not only amoung students but professionals as well. They vary just as wildly in price and quality . This Bagstellar Laptop Backpak checks all the boxes without breaking the bank.

    It falls into the feather weight category weighing in at slightly more than 1lb. Backpack is large enough to hold a 15" laptop and a few changes of clothes in the main compartment. There are 3 additional varying sized zippered compartments. All hardware is black and blends in nicely.

    The bag features horizontal quilted channels giving it the puffer esthetic.

    Material is a strong lightweight polyester with reinforced stitching. Zippers glide easily making additions or removals quick and efficient. I almost forgot to mention there are side pockets large enough to accommodate that giant eco-friendly water bottle.

    I really can't say enough about it. It's attractive, well made, affordable and extremely functional. It also adapts to travel excursions fitting nicely on a luggage handle and under seats. Adjustable back straps are well padded for comfort. Job well done Bagstellar!

    Nice Basic Backpack, Not A Lot Of Interior Pockets
    Reviewed in the United States on September 5, 2026
    Color: Sage Green
    Vine Customer Review of Free Product
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This is a very nice, well made backpack. Each pocket is big and roomy and easy to access. This would be a great bag for a student to carry books and school stuff. This is also roomy enough to use as a weekend bag or overnight bag. There are not really any smaller interior pockets. There are two slip pockets in the smaller front compartment, and there is a larger zip pocket in the large compartment. There is no security pocket. The hidden pocket is on the very front so if the pack is on your back, that pocket is one of the easiest to open. Not secure. I like to use backpacks as a purse/Mom Bag for big outings, and there are not enough smaller interior pockets for me to use this bag in that manner. The laptop pocket is somewhat padded but not really enough to be doing much protecting. I can fit a 32 oz. water bottle in the side pockets. It is still a good, sturdy bag for books or larger items. Nice standard backpack.

    We lost all of our backpacks during a house move and had to replace them for a lot of travel that we do. I got my wife a really nice full sized pack that holds lots of stuff and has many pockets and features. Only problem was it became too heavy and big for her ( yeah, she puts too much in it). I saw this medium sized light weight model and she loves it. A nice shade of green happens to match her luggage, these come in lots of colors. It doesn't have all the hooks, loops, straps etc. of many travel bags, but the light weight is perfect for my older wife. It looks great. The quilted, puffer style really looks like a professionals backpack. The extra large beverage holder with the strap are a plus. Our bottles constantly roll out. She plans to take this one on our next trip.
